kn5000-ezo: Lane open4/kn5000-b-display (2026-10-31): every MN89304 register write is now listed (probe notes/open4-kn5000-b/display/probes/vga_register_writes.py). Extended set: seq 0x06 is an unlock (0x01 before, 0x00 after every extended write); seq 0x09 is an index and seq 0x0A/0x0B/0x0C three data registers (18 entries, table in the README); seq 0x07=0x20, 0x08=0x01, 0x0D=0x03, 0x0F=0x00 at boot but 0x44 at run time (0x00 when the region code is 4), seq 0x13=0x01 at run time only, CRTC 0x19=0x00, 0x1A=0x10, port 0x3C3=0x01 (read back by the factory LCD test). VGA_Initialize (0xFB2B06, display init phase 0) overrides the boot VGA_Setup: horizontal total 0x50 (boot 0x65) and a 256-entry palette from work RAM 0xE3E8 rounded to 4 bits. VGA_CRTCTiming_ByteData was a misnamed, unreferenced, never-returning palette loader (now VGA_WritePalette256_Unterminated); the unlabelled code after it is a second extended-sequencer table (VGA_ConfigExtSequencer_AltA), and _Alt is now _AltB; neither is called. Commit 50af45bc3 (all five trees, byte-identical). Meanings stay unknown: no MN89304 datasheet exists; MAME ignores these registers and displays correctly. Website page draft: notes/open4-kn5000-b/display/README.md, section kn5000-ezo (display-subsystem.md 'MN89304 Extended Registers'). The 916 records that name a panel switch sit on a fixed grid: five side rows at y = 30 + 42n (26 high; left boxes from x 8, right from x 163, 149 wide; right value boxes 281, 31 x 18), eight bottom slots at x = 4 + 40k, y 216 (32 x 23, wide boxes span 2-3 slots), EXIT in the last slot. No fixed status bar exists. The probe's --png draws the zones; an annotated MAME screenshot is optional for the docs lane. kn5000-nmg: Lane open4/kn5000-b-display (2026-10-31): there is no screen-transition state machine. The three 'transition' words 0x2749A/0x2749E/0x274A2 are the panel's held-switch masks: SwbtB3_OnPanelEvent sets bit N for group N's UP / DOWN switch of the 0xA9 records and their AND picks four combos (0x1100 CaptureLcd on a 0xFF build, 0xA1 TITLE_SOFTVER, 0x91 TITLE_PS, 0x89 EVT_SHOW to object 7); MainTitleControl clears them on every title/mode change. Renamed PANEL_SW_HELD_UP/_DOWN/_BOTH in all trees; MainTitleCtrl_ChangeTitle's speculative header replaced (it only records the title ids, requests indicator 0x61, clears the masks and resets the voice state); 0x274A6-0x274AE named (TITLE_FLAGS_LATCHED/_PENDING/_DELAY, OTHER_PART_LED_PENDING/_DELAY: the delayed MT_SetTitleFlag / MT_OtherPartLed requests) and MainTitleControl's case labels renamed. SlideBase/SlideMove are bitmap resources 2/3 (slide.bmp, slmove.bmp, slider art), unused by any record. Commit 50af45bc3.
